n: Code.org Hour of Code Unplugged Activities
t: Five free unplugged lessons on robots, compression, encryption, dance, and AI ethics.
steps: Find the Hour of Code unplugged unit on the Code.org site.
Pick one lesson that fits your grade band.
Check whether the lesson needs a video or a widget.
Teach the lesson in 15 to 45 minutes.
Try Our AI Code of Ethics with older students.
